run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup phase runs 5 calls before timing the main iterations
test_time_func_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations for finer benchmarking control
test_time_func_naming: test time_func with a custom name parameter to label benchmark output
summarize_time_func: summarize the time_func utility that benchmarks callables using perf_counter and prints average ms
